closed_findings.closure: The new wrapper requires list/tuple with at most8 safe bounded components before any write; generators and malformed parts are rejected by regressions.
closed_findings.finding: Passing an iterator through the frozen directory primitive could consume it during validation and lose intended path parts.

closed_findings.closure: Enumeration counts all entries, including ignored names, and refuses above2048 before sorting.
closed_findings.finding: A returned-cycle limit alone did not bound directory enumeration and sorting.

closed_findings.closure: The wrapper normalizes its root to an absolute path before I/O and returned relative-path construction; a disposable relative-root write regression passes.
closed_findings.finding: Relative roots could succeed at writing but fail path.relative_to(root) while returning the receipt.

scope_limits: The caller must supply approved expected source bindings and verify current registered source/model/cohort selection; the I/O wrapper does not authorize a registry.
Caller must provision a separate new experiment sink; generic persist helpers do not themselves decide which study directory the caller is authorized to write.
Reviewed intended caller uses Path roots; downstream file-store components impose an effective64-character bound even though the wrapper accepts up to96 before delegation.
Root directory ownership is assumed; path checks are not an administrator-resistant sandbox against concurrent directory replacement.
File fsync/readback is not an unsupported guarantee of directory-entry crash durability.
Owner ran30focusedtests; reviewer reread source/tests without rerunning tests or touching active registered sources.
verified_semantics: Fixed GBP_USD/official_midpoint source paths and bounded cycle-name discovery; source contents and receipt are independently checked rather than trusted from names.
Raw S5 bytes and exact receipt are retained; the new read starts after original capture completion and records actual completion separately.
Frozen mapper validates original source identity, hashes, metadata and capture clocks; this helper performs no broker GET.
Curve anchor requires original issue/publication/consumption stage claims and matching GBP_USD, midpoint convention, expected cohort and exact curve identity.

Frozen filesystem consumer validates the retained curve/publication descriptor and creates a fresh consumption in memory with persist_consumption=False; original pilot files and publication clocks are unchanged.
Initial anchor requires issue age0–120seconds, exactly one admitted native H1 forecast node and3300–3600seconds of original target remaining.
New evidence writes are exclusive, bounded, fsynced and independently read back before actual publication completion is returned; failures/orphans are never overwritten or deleted.
Frozen path primitives reject symlinks/junctions/reparse points and changed/oversized reads within the documented trusted-root boundary.
No account-data reads, order calls or execution authority are introduced.
